description: Security rules for Rust files — flags unsafe blocks, unwrap panics, and hardcoded secrets

unsafe.description: Unsafe block usage — requires justification comment

rules.description: unsafe blocks must have a SAFETY comment explaining the invariant
rules.message: Add a // SAFETY: comment before this unsafe block explaining why the invariants are upheld

rules.description: Avoid .unwrap() in production code — prefer proper error handling
rules.message: .unwrap() panics on None/Err — use match, ?, or .unwrap_or_else() instead

secrets.description: No hardcoded secrets in Rust files

rules.description: No hardcoded API keys, tokens, or passwords
rules.message: Hardcoded secret detected — use std::env::var or a secrets crate
